reference_role: makeup placement color-distribution and surface-finish reference only
identity_policy: generate an original adult subject; do not use the source as biometric identity evidence
global_proposition: restrained polished natural makeup in which readable skin remains dominant and eye cheek and lip contrast stay mutually balanced

observed_components.complexion: sheer-to-light satin correction with fine skin texture and natural tonal variation still readable
observed_components.brows: softly groomed low-arch brows with individual hairs retained
observed_components.eyeshadow: neutral taupe-brown wash deepest near the upper lash line and softly diffused through the crease
observed_components.eyeliner: slim interlash definition with a very short tapered outer extension
observed_components.lashes: clean separated upper lashes with restrained volume
observed_components.cheeks: subtle muted rose flush without a sharp placement boundary
observed_components.lips: muted rosy-coral color strongest near the inner center and diffused toward the vermilion edge with a low satin-balm sheen
observed_components.balance: no high-contrast region displaces the complexion as the visual hierarchy owner

uncertainties: exact product formulas and pigment names cannot be inferred from pixels
some cheek color may be influenced by complexion lighting
identity ethnicity health and attractiveness are outside the observation

randomization.method: Ruby Array shuffle with Random seeded by the first eight hexadecimal characters of source_sha256
